info.title: Arch Forward Observations System API
info.description: Local unprivileged read-only REST API for Arch Linux security telemetry, package inventory, and system findings.

get.summary: Lists suggested remediation commands awaiting or having received human approval (US-28).

patch.summary: Records explicit human approval or rejection for a suggested action without auto-executing it (US-28).

post.summary: Exchanges the local API token for an `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict` session cookie.
Invalidates the current session and clears the session cookie (requires CSRF header).

get.summary: Returns whether the current browser session is authenticated and provides the active CSRF token.
Lists captured DNS queries attributed to processes with cursor pagination (US-17).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 200).

get.summary: Lists raw collector events with cursor pagination and severity/time/entity filters.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 200).

get.summary: Lists security findings with cursor pagination and severity/status/time/entity filters.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 200).

patch.summary: Updates a finding status (`new`, `acknowledged`, `ignored`, `resolved`) with audit logging (US-23).

get.summary: Returns the audit trail for a specific finding (US-23).

post.summary:
Explains a finding using the local Ollama LLM (`qwen2.5-coder:14b` by default) enriched with
offline Arch Wiki RAG citations and cached by finding hash (US-26, US-27, US-28).

get.summary: Lists minute-aggregated network flows with cursor pagination and time/entity filters.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 200).

get.summary: Returns API liveness status and verifies read-only SQLite access.
Returns the latest self-health telemetry recorded by the collector daemon (US-30).
Lists listening network sockets attributed to processes and owning packages (US-07).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 200).

get.summary: Lists installed packages from the ALPM inventory with cursor pagination and filters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 200).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on package name or description.

parameters.name: foreign_only
parameters.description: Filter only foreign (AUR / local) packages when true.

get.summary: Lists active YAML Sigma detection rules and their MITRE ATT&CK mappings (US-29).
Lists systemd services and cgroup resource metrics with cursor pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 200).

get.summary:
Real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream emitting newly recorded findings (US-21).
Supports automatic reconnection via `Last-Event-ID` or `?after_id=...`.
Returns aggregated system security and inventory metrics for the overview dashboard.
Lists configured finding suppressions (US-23).

post.summary: Creates or updates a suppression rule for a `(rule_id, entity_type, entity_id)` tuple (US-23).

get.summary: Returns URLhaus and Feodo Tracker indicator counts and last sync timestamps (US-18).

Returns a unified chronological timeline correlating events, findings, listeners, flows, and DNS
for a single package, service, process, or persistence entity (US-24).
Lists known entities from findings, events, and processes for timeline selection (US-24).
Searches the offline Arch Wiki RAG index (US-27).

ActionStatus.description: Approval lifecycle state for a suggested remediation command (US-28).

AuthStatus.description: Current authentication session status and CSRF token.

CollectorHealth.description: Self-health metrics reported by the collector daemon (US-30).

CreateSuppressionRequest.description: Request body to create a suppression rule (US-23).

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

DnsQuery.description: Captured DNS query attributed to a process and package (US-17).

EntityTimelineResponse.description: Chronological correlated timeline for a package, service, process, or other entity (US-24).

Event.description: Raw event emitted by the collector.

ExplainFindingRequest.description: Optional request body when requesting an LLM explanation (US-26).

Finding.description: Security or system finding produced by deterministic rules.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

FindingAuditEntry.description: Audit log record tracking finding state transitions and suppression actions.

FindingAuditResponse.description: Response containing audit history for a finding.

FindingStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a security or operational finding.

Flow1m.description: Network flow aggregated per minute and process.

bucket_ts.description: Minute bucket start timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

InstallReason.description: Reason a package is installed in the local ALPM database.

Listener.description: Listening socket attributed to a process and owning package.

LlmExplanation.description: Validated LLM explanation for a security finding (US-26).

LoginRequest.description: Login request using the local API token.

MutationAck.description: Generic confirmation response for write commands forwarded to the collector.

Package.description: Installed package metadata captured from ALPM.

install_date.description: Install date in Unix milliseconds (if available from ALPM).

RagSource.description: Cited Arch Wiki passage returned by local RAG (US-27).

ReviewActionRequest.description: Request body to approve or reject a suggested action (US-28).

Rule.description: Rule configuration stored in the database.

Service.description: Systemd unit and cgroup consumption snapshot.

Severity.description: Severity level shared across events, findings, and rules.

Suppression.description: Suppression rule excluding a `(rule_id, entity_type, entity_id)` tuple until optional expiration.

ThreatFeedStatus.description: Sync status for an external threat intelligence feed (US-18).

ThreatIntelStatusResponse.description: Summary of configured threat intelligence feeds and last sync timestamps (US-18).

ts_sec.description: Bucket timestamp in Unix seconds (directly usable by uPlot).

TimelineEntitiesResponse.description: List of entities with recent telemetry for quick timeline selection (US-24).

TimelineEntityRef.description: Reference to a discoverable entity for timeline inspection (US-24).

TimelineEntry.description: Unified chronological entry in an entity timeline (US-24).

TopProcessTraffic.description: Top network process entry in the summary dashboard.

TopServiceUsage.description: Top resource-consuming service entry in the summary dashboard.

UpdateFindingRequest.description: Request body to update a finding's status (US-23).

WikiSearchResponse.description: Search results from the offline Arch Wiki index (US-27).
